snippet.title: CoFishing — Announce Trailer | A fishing sim you play together
snippet.description:
Wishlist CoFishing on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5107300/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=announce-nov26&utm_content=trailer16x9

CoFishing is a hardcore fishing simulator built around fishing together. Play solo or in a group of up to five, share your tackle, your know-how and your sense of humor, and fight fish that fight back. Free to play. In development for PC and consoles.

🎣 FISH TOGETHER: groups of up to five on the same water
🐟 FISH FIGHTS: every fish behaves differently, so read it to land it
🧢 BE YOUR OWN ANGLER: build, appearance, outfit and logos
🎯 REAL TECHNIQUE: skills and a wide range of rods, reels, lines, lures and rigs
🌍 WATERS: freshwater and saltwater locations from all over the world
🚤 EXPLORE AND COLLECT: on foot or by boat, and fill your fish collection

Release date to be announced. A playable demo is planned.

▶ Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5107300/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=announce-nov26&utm_content=trailer16x9-footer
💬 Discord: https://discord.gg/22WbnrSneX
🌐 Website and press kit: https://cofishinggame.com
🦋 Bluesky: https://bsky.app/profile/cofishinggame.com
𝕏 X: https://x.com/CoFishingGame
